title: Lima virreinal: Balcones de celosía y señorío
goal: Investigate the viceregal architecture of Lima, Mudejar latticed balconies, and the tapada limeña phenomenon.
grammar: urbanismo colonial de Lima, balcones voladizos de celosía mudéjar y sociedad virreinal

items: Analyze the architectural palimpsest of the City of Kings founded in 1535.
Explore the unique social anonymity and freedom exercised by the tapadas limeñas.
Deploy colonial history, viceregal aristocracy, and architecture vocabulary (celosía, virreinato, señorío, conventual).
